correctness.evidence: Independent recompile/replay of original F251 kernel on 9460×9453 derivative matrix returned 9453 pivots. Nonzero minor transfers to Q and upper semicontinuity to general points; virtual dimension 9453−9460−1=−8. Shifted auxiliary kernel has out-of-bounds factorial initialization, not needed for base proof.

originality.evidence: Ciliberto–Miranda arXiv:0812.0032 cover d/m≥174/55, while 136/43 is below; explicit specialization resolves this individual cell using standard rank method.

scientific_value.evidence: Exact reproducible emptiness certificate for one previously uncovered homogeneous ten-point interpolation cell, with no inference to full Nagata/SHGH strip.

limitations: Auxiliary shifted C implementation writes one past its factorial allocation; base-kernel full-rank proof independently reran.
